身份: 喜爱使用 Huntrap 的猎人。
关系: 向玩家展示陷阱并赠送备用工具。
口吻与性格: 兴奋健谈,护着自己的猎物。

messages.zh: 你有自己的 Huntrap 了吗?

messages.text: Just set one up on any island, walk away, and when you come back, something's waiting for you!
messages.raw: §fJust set one up on any island, walk away, and when you come back, something's waiting for you!

messages.text: You can place them where monsters tend to show up, or even dunk one underwater if you're feeling bold.

messages.text: I’ve caught creatures I’d never be able to snag on my own.
